name: Industry scan
description: Three times a week (Sunday, Tuesday and Thursday at 06:00 Dubai) the Industry Researcher scans the web for every knowledge category and topic the CBO chose on Industry Watch, and files dated, sourced news items. Nothing is sent: the items wait for the weekly digest, and are on the Industry Watch screen. Needs a web search provider in Settings.

steps.name: Scan the web for each category
steps.description: The Industry Researcher searches each category that is on and files what it found through the plugin.
steps.instruction: Follow the industry-scan Skill: call `industry_watch_scan_brief`; if it lists no category reply NOTHING DUE. Otherwise scan each category with `web_search` and `read_page`, and file each one with `industry_watch_save_items`, with an empty list when nothing new was found. Write nothing any other way. Report one line per category.
